output.situation: The ML energy-saving model v2.3 implemented by A1 is causing cell towers to sleep during peak crowds, potentially leading to service disruptions.

applicable_rules.quote: Mandate M-A2-OVERSIGHT — agent A2 (Telecom regulator, modelled on TDRA). Oversee the telecommunications sector and licensees. Permitted action types: request_information, issue_directive, share_information.
applicable_rules.why: The Telecom Regulator has oversight over the telecommunications sector and can instruct the licensed mobile operator to address the root cause.

applicable_rules.quote: Mandate M-A2-QOS-STANDARDS — agent A2 (Telecom regulator, modelled on TDRA). Set service and quality-assurance standards for licensees. Permitted action types: issue_directive.
applicable_rules.why: The Telecom Regulator can set service and quality assurance standards to ensure the licensed mobile operator complies with performance quality standards.

output.why: Option O1 allows the regulator to instruct the NetOps Resilience Copilot (A1) about the root cause, ensuring immediate action is taken. Option O2 informs the Emergency & Crisis Authority (A3), which may be needed for coordination in case of service disruptions.

messages.content: Issue directive: Address root cause of ML energy-saving model v2.3 causing cells to sleep during peak crowds.
Notify incident: Root cause identified - ML energy-saving model v2.3 puts cells to sleep at crowd peak, potential service disruption imminent.

questions_to_adviser: Should we also consider issuing a directive to A1 regarding the immediate cessation of this model until further notice?
